newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar edges lower in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar edges lower in late trading.

text.p: White sugar futures continued their slide in later trading to finish just off the day's lows on Tuesday.
Activity was generally routine and volume light and the generally bearish tone felt earlier continued, traders said.
They said short covering was behind the slight strength seen after the weak start to the session thjis morning.
December closed $2.00 lower at $323.50, just 20 cents above the intraday low hit earlier.
March was $1.30 down at $320.40 and volume was concentrated on the front month which traded 1,319 lots compared with the March total of 515 lots.
"There are a couple of AAs but nothing out of the ordinary. It's found a bit of strength but there's probably still a bit more downwards movement in it," said one trader.
Technical analysts said while December's resistance was pegged at $327.00, the outlook for the market could still be viewed as bearish.
The December contract also dominated activity on the Paris market, where just 292 lots were traded. It stood $1.70 lower at $324.50.
